description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans framework, specifically testing the behavior of the consistent ring provider during silo failures and joins. It includes test setup, configuration, and various test scenarios involving silo failures, recoveries, and key distribution verification.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProviderTests_Silo
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the Orleans consistent ring provider during silo failures and joins, including setup, configuration, and various test scenarios.

methods.name: FailureTest
methods.description: Simulates failures of silos based on the specified fail code and number of failures, then verifies key distribution before and after failures.

methods.name: JoinTest
methods.description: Tests the joining of new silos into the cluster and verifies key distribution.

methods.name: VerificationScenario
methods.description: Verifies that a specific key maps to the correct silo across the cluster.

methods.name: VerifyKey
methods.description: Checks that a given key maps to the expected silo across all active silos.

methods.name: getSilosToFail
methods.description: Selects silos to fail based on the specified fail mode (first, last, random).

methods.name: PickKey
methods.description: Generates a key that is responsible for a specific silo according to the consistent ring.
